items.title: AI tools for each team
items.text: A planned rollout of the right AI tool for each department, with training first.

items.title: AI use policy
items.text: Clear rules for which AI tools to use and what data can go into them. With HR for review.

items.title: AI roundtable
items.text: A standing group that collects how people are using AI, plans training and handles AI license requests.

items.title: AI second reader for invoices
items.text: AI reads each invoice and pay application alongside the scanner. Where they disagree, or a check fails, it goes to a person with the reason shown.

items.title: AP Desk
items.text: Pay applications and invoices from payables@ in one queue: checked against Procore and ComputerEase, routed to the right approver and tracked until entered.

items.title: BHC Assistant (pilot)
items.text: Ask about company basics, processes and where to find things, answered only from approved Bailey-Harris sources.

items.title: Change order recap helper (pilot)
items.text: Fills in the owner's change order recap from trade partner proposals, then sets up a draft change event in Procore for the PM to check and send.

items.title: AI check on insurance certificates
items.text: A second reader on incoming certificates and endorsements that flags what is missing before anyone reviews it.

items.title: Send a COI, it gets filed
items.text: Forward a certificate of insurance to one address (or drop it in one place) and it is filed in Billy against the right job and trade partner.

items.title: Competent person tracking
items.text: Shows which competent person forms are on file for each active job, pulled from Procore forms.

items.title: Compliance desk
items.text: Which trade partners are covered to be on site and get paid, by job, straight from Billy.

items.title: Compliance notes and PM updates
items.text: Each trade partner now has notes and a history of requests. A note can be emailed straight to the job's PM team, with a link back to that trade partner.

items.title: Crew planning for self-perform
items.text: Match crews to work by skill and track productivity, built with Auburn University Building Science as a research partner.

items.title: Who has the contract to sign
items.text: The buyout view shows when a subcontract is out for signature and whether it is waiting on us or the trade partner.

items.title: Field app for receipts and time
items.text: One phone app for snapping card receipts and, later, logging hours by job and cost code. Managers approve in the app and accounting gets a clean weekly batch. Replaces FieldEase.

items.title: More in the field app
items.text: Daily crew assignments, time-and-material tickets and jobsite forms, in the same app as receipts and time.

items.title: IT vendor invoice capture
items.text: Utility, phone and copier invoices are read from payables@ and logged automatically for budget tracking.

items.title: One job list across systems
items.text: Every job's Procore, ComputerEase and Unanet numbers, PM team and status in one table, so every desk and app agrees on which job is which.

items.title: Employee Home
items.text: One starting page for every desk, with the apps you use and who is out this week.

items.title: Lien waiver tracking
items.text: See which waivers are in and which are still owed for each payment.

items.title: Trade partner pay app portal
items.text: Each month trade partners get a secure link with their contract and change orders filled in. They enter this period and sign, and it lands on the AP Desk.

items.title: Precon desk
items.text: Past project history for pricing new work: cost per square foot, schedule and fee from comparable jobs.

items.title: Trade partner ratings and prequal
items.text: Ratings from past jobs, prequalification files and diversity classifications for every trade partner.

items.title: Procore assistant (pilot)
items.text: Ask plain questions about a job and get answers straight from Procore: RFIs, submittals, commitments. Read-only. Two field and project leaders are piloting it.

items.title: Project Information dashboard
items.text: Contract, cost, forecast, change orders and buyout for every active job in one place, from Procore and ComputerEase.

items.title: Schedule update briefing
items.text: After each schedule update, a short plain-English summary: what moved, why, what is at risk next, and who owns the next step.

items.title: Schedule trends on the project dashboard
items.text: Milestones, how the finish date has moved between updates, and critical work for each job, next to cost and change orders.

items.title: Schedule health check
items.text: Each time a schedule is updated, an automatic check flags missing logic, hard dates, open ends and stale progress, with a simple score, before anyone relies on it.

items.title: Three-week look-ahead for the field
items.text: A look-ahead pulled from the job schedule that superintendents can confirm or correct from the jobsite, so the schedule matches what is really happening.

items.title: Standard schedule setup
items.text: One way to code and build every job schedule, so schedules can be checked automatically and compared across jobs.

items.title: Self-perform takeoff and estimating
items.text: Faster quantity takeoff and pricing for concrete and other self-perform scopes, with Auburn University Building Science.

items.title: Submittals assistant
items.text: Help preparing and checking submittals against the spec, so less goes back and forth.
